pages.quiz:
MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

2. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 6

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

4. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 2

5. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

6. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27
   C. 27.6
   D. 33

7. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 15.7

8. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 32
   C. 22
   D. 55

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 75
   B. 20
   C. 30
   D. 40

11. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 29
   C. 23.6
   D. 23

12. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19
   C. 25
   D. 19.7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
